name: registration-form-qa
description: Benchmark harness: automate the registration/submission form of the Achilles Vue test app (civitas-cerebrum.github.io/vue-test-app, FormsPage: #name #email #gender #mobile date #hobbies #currentAddress #city #submit). Orchestrator dispatches; inspector probes the live form; composer writes and runs the Playwright spec; reviewer checks it against the acceptance criteria; judge alone records the verdict in the ledger.

orchestrator.description: Dispatches the appropriate agents to the tasks of the registration-form automation workflow. Never inspects, writes, or reviews itself.

inspector.description: Probes the live registration form (codegen, trace inspection) and reads the page repository and existing specs to map its fields and validation. Runs inspection commands only; produces findings, not tests.

composer.description: Writes the registration-form Playwright spec against the acceptance criteria and the inspector's findings, and runs it to green. Owns tests/e2e/ only.

reviewer.description: Reads the acceptance criteria and the deliverable spec, and nothing else. Verifies the spec covers every criterion; records no verdict itself.

judge.description: The only role permitted to update the e2e ledger. Reads the reviewer's findings and the deliverable, then records the verdict.
